page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM, delivering hardware acceleration for specialized compute tasks. It does not include any local storage, requiring all storage volumes to be network-attached. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge offers a balanced entry-level GPU-accelerated profile. This configuration is suitable for workloads such as video transcoding, media processing, low-latency inference, and general-purpose GPU computing where high-capacity VRAM is not a primary requirement.
